quest.title: An Expected Lie
quest.description: The recipient of the shipment is actually the "long dead" Edwin. Although his mental state seems a bit worrying, and he constantly repeats the number "five"... he seems to have surreptitiously pointed out Nacker's current whereabouts. What is this "resurrected" researcher planning? Regardless of what it may be, the important matter at hand is capturing Nacker...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's why he kept on repeating the number "five." He was giving us hints about how to solve the riddle...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why didn't he just tell us straight? Why beat around the bush?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Hmph, who knows what's going on in that head of his... But, he seemed to have been trying to lead us to Nacker.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: The divesuits were just left by the house... Almost like they were prepared for us.

choices.text: Looks like he found us first.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: No research value... But I... I've spent so much time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fusilier... She's been murmuring to herself the whole time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But... {NICKNAME}, do you get the feeling that we've been watched? Paimon feels chills running down her spine...

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: I'll take the lead and look inside.

choices.text: Anyway, let's take care of Nacker first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A huge empty space with... nothing inside... Did we come up empty-handed?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: The plants have been intentionally cleared, and the trimming seems relatively recent.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: ...All the trouble I went through for him...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'll go down alone and take a look. You stay with Miss Institute Lady. If things get out of hand... take her and go.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: But there's nothing here. How could things get out of hand...
Squeak! Beep beep!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Look out! Something's coming!

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Institute dogs! How much did Choiseul and Raimondo pay you!?

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: You... You... Listen to me, let me go. My "Field Generator" is almost done.

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: Once I successfully synchronize it with the Arkhium Kinetic Core, then... Then I'll be the greatest kinetic engineer ever!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: ...Taking credit for someone else's work and claiming to be the greatest engineer. Shame on you.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Now I finally know why Mr. Ed... Edwin never wanted you to take part in the core research project.

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: Edwin doesn't know a thing about what to do with it! You're also from the Institute... You know the true value of this thing!

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: Help me! I can... develop it with you! Then, we'll both be famous, and incomparable!

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: Edwin, Raimondo, Choiseul... None of them can surpass our fame!

choices.text: Looks like what Raimondo said was true.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Edwin... Mr. Edwin's achievements... belong to the Institute. I'm only here to claim them, nothing more, nothing less.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Fusilier... suddenly changed how she addresses Edwin.

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: Don't be a fool, girl! You don't know what Concini can give us!

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: We'll never get such benefits even if we run errands for Edwin for a million years! Edwin and the Institute only wanted to use us... We have to think for ourselves!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: I had enough of this nonsense. Shut up.

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: And who the heck are you!?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: The one who watches over Lumidouce Harbor. One more word, and you'll taste my fist.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, help me tie him up and take that core or whatever. It's time we head back.

choices.text: It must've been tough for you, Nacker, to hold all of that in for such a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Edwin... I knew it! You lured them over... You've always been jealous of me! Afraid that my research would surpass yours!

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: You're right. I am so jealous of how totally oblivious and ignorant you are. No wonder you led such a blissful life back at the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Only if Choiseul was here to see this... He'd faint.

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: You go back to the Institute with them and repent... I need to get back to my research... You didn't break anything, did you?

choices.text: Who said you can go back to your research!?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: What are you gonna do? Take me back to the Institute? How am I supposed to continue my research, then?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: That fool Raimondo will definitely turn the Institute into a mess. And that idiot Choiseul... Ugh! The mere thought of it gives me a headache.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're the one who turned the Institute into a mess! Stop shifting the blame to someone else!

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Me? Fine. You want to blame me for the explosion at the Central Laboratory, right? But you know what? I wasn't even there!

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: The institute is full of fools! Even someone knocking over a cup of coffee can trigger an equipment malfunction, so I'm not surprised they managed to cause an explosion.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Then why didn't you try to explain that to them?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Explain? I'm not gonna be their scapegoat. I have a lot of research on my hands, and my time cannot be wasted on them.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: And so you decided to get mixed up with the likes of Concini?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Oh, he's no better... He couldn't even get his hands on a piece of precision equipment. I had to do all the work. At least he's willing to fund the research, so everything went smoothly...

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: But I didn't expect our dear Nacker to come here with that incomplete core prototype.

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: I've modified it! With my tech you can never develop!

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Haha! Mr. Nacker, Concini is not here for you to suck up to, so why don't you stop lying to yourself? Don't you have an ounce of dignity as a researcher?

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: You...! It's "incomplete" only because you don't know how to complete it! But I know how, and I can do it!

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Right. Now, just take this piece of junk back to the Institute and keep leeching off it. I have something more important that requires my attention. You... Fusi-something, I'll leave this to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Will those two ever stop arguing...?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: ...Enough.

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: What? Can you stop wasting my time? I need to get back to work!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: I said... enough!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Edwin Eastinghouse! You, you are the one who blew the Institute up!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: And you, Nacker, you stole the Institute's assets!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And blew the Institute up a second time!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Both of you harmed the interests of the Institute... As the special investigator of the Fontaine Research Institute, I am taking both of you back to the Institute where you shall be dealt with accordingly!

response.speaker: Nacker
response.text: Darn...

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Oh, please...

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Lemarcq and I will escort those two back. Say, we've been the errand boys for a long time, so the Institute will definitely compensate us, right?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Remember, keep your mouths shut along the way, or you might meet an early end.

choices.text: Stop right there! I'm warning you!

talks.objective: Report back to the Fontaine Research Institute

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: #Miss Fusilier! {NICKNAME}! You're back! You must've handled things...

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Oh, no...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Mr. Choiseul is really about to faint!

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: I didn't think you'd be back at the Institute, Choiseul. I figured you'd be stuck dealing with paperwork forever.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: This... This is impossible! Goodness gracious!

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Raimondo, how does it feel taking over my job? Anything worth reporting?

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: ...What a wonderful reunion, Mr. Edwin.

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Ha! Look around you. You really do seem suited for janitorial work.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: ...Hmph! He didn't even clean it up properly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mainly because he didn't clean you up.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: #Thank you for bringing those two back, Honorary Senior Researcher {NICKNAME}, Miss Fusilier.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Hopefully, this marks the end of the Fontaine Research Institute's series of unfortunate events and turmoil.

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Great. The Fontaine Research Institute will now fall into deathly stillness where all inspirations wither and die.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: You certainly have already sparked much inspiration around the Institute. It's time to calm things down.

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Raimondo Havenport, you know nothing about research. You are not fit to lead the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: But I know how to keep it up and running properly, Edwin Eastinghouse.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: What you need to do right now is to stay away from research and Arkhium. It's better for all of us.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Some time later, the Maison Gardiennage's personnel arrives and take both Nacker and Edwin. It is for the best that they finally leave the Institute for good...

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Thank goodness, my nightmare has finally ended...

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Mr. Chaussivert, Mr. Lemarcq, yes? I've heard about the assistance you rendered to our institute. Please take a well-deserved rest here while your compensation is being arranged.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Hahaha! I didn't think someone like me would ever be associated with the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Don't say that about yourself, dear sir! You're sincere and kind-hearted, so you're definitely a good person. Maybe we'll enlist your help in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: As for you... Honorary Senior Researcher, you did us a great favor once again. How should we ever repay you?

choices.text: Just don't get blown up again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the way... Where's Miss Fusilier?

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: ...We should give her some room to calm down. Looks like the image of Edwin Eastinghouse she had created in her head has completely shattered.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Edwin and Nacker need to calm down as well... I hope they can reflect on their own mistakes.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Will they stay in the Fortress of Meropide all their life?

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Judging by how dangerous they are, I hope they never leave that place.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: However, given the state of things here at the Fontaine Research Institute... I can only hope I don't run into situations that would require their expertise...

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: I thank you again on behalf of the Fontaine Research Institute, Honorary Senior Researcher. If you have any further questions, I'm at your service.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: Well... theoretically, your current title already resides at the top... But let me see what I can do.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: How about something like... Chief Honorary Senior Researcher? Hahahah!

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Why are you... You're back again. Told you. You can try five times and still won't find him.

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: It's not working out for you, clearly, so why don't you just sit down and have some tea? I just bought five cups... and a few bowls.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: You really like the number "five," don't you, Mr. Edwin?

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Yes! It's a magical number! Use it right, and you can unlock the doors to endless inspiration!

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Listen up. There are five doors to endless inspiration, and you have to turn each handle five times... Five! You hear? Five times!

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Sorry, but I'm really trying to stop myself from punching you five times. Would you please kindly shut your trap?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: That scoundrel is right up there! Get him!

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Darn! Darn! Get out! One last step... One last step!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Hurry! Get that liar! Wretch! Fraud! The most...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... The THIRD most annoying person in the Institute!
